coherent_interface: one fresh empirical joint-row event per discovered group and time; owners receive projections, never independent copies

coverage_and_obstructions.minimality_scope: each channel suffix quotient separately, relative to the learned response family and all allowed other-channel contexts; not a unique global physical state

wrong_grouping_novel_feedback_witness.missing_joint_distinction: all one- and two-coordinate projections of the synthetic triple are independent uniform, while the triple is not
wrong_grouping_novel_feedback_witness.novel_feedback_controller: after one readout, subtract learned conditional means and set a selected next action to the product of these three residuals
wrong_grouping_novel_feedback_witness.repair: retain the learned positive three-coordinate joint event and project it coherently through both crossing fragment families

cross_description_checks.role: software smoke tests; all-feedback statistical guarantee comes from local certificate and chain rule, not these controllers

alternative_Bernstein_bound_not_simultan.role: comparison only, not minimized with the primary bound and not included in the primary confidence claim

probability_certificate.bound: Agrawal gamma MGF across independent block histograms; feedback chain rule KL(Q_traj||P_traj)<=H*sum KL(Q_g||P_g); Pinsker; same initial memory; arbitrary nonanticipating legal controllers

simulator_audit.status: simulator-side audit ONLY; not the source of observational confidence

support_certificate.scope: exact response equality within declared integer degree<=5 / symmetric binary-noise universe, not validation of universe
